title: GeoFP8: Geometry-Aware FP8 Gradient Compression for Distributed LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2607.07494v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gradient communication is a primary scaling bottleneck in large language model (LLM) pretraining. Communicating gradients in low-precision formats, such as FP8 and NVFP4, can significantly reduce the communication volume. Existing methods quantize gradients via linear or nonlinear mappings in Euclidean space, often degrading model performance because highly anisotropic gradients incur direction-dependent distortion. We present GeoFP8, a geometry-informed gradient scaling method that performs low-precision communication in geometry-aware coordinates. By transforming gradients into a near-isotropic space before quantization, GeoFP8 makes low-precision representations substantially more faithful to their high-precision counterparts. GeoFP8 only changes the coordinate system used for low-precision gradient communication and does not change the optimizer, training recipe, communication collective, or low-precision format. translated_title: GeoFP8：面向分布式大语言模型训练的几何感知FP8梯度压缩
translated_abstract: 梯度通信是大语言模型（LLM）预训练中的主要扩展瓶颈。以FP8和NVFP4等低精度格式传输梯度可以显著减少通信量。现有方法通过欧几里得空间中的线性或非线性映射对梯度进行量化，由于高度各向异性的梯度会产生方向相关的失真，因而常常导致模型性能下降。我们提出GeoFP8，一种基于几何信息的梯度缩放方法，可在几何感知的坐标系中执行低精度通信。通过在量化之前将梯度变换到近似各向同性的空间，GeoFP8使低精度表示在很大程度上更忠实于其高精度对应物。GeoFP8仅改变用于低精度梯度通信的坐标系，而不改变优化器、训练方案、通信集合操作或低精度格式。
tldr: GeoFP8通过在量化前将梯度变换到几何感知的近各向同性坐标系，大幅降低FP8低精度梯度通信中的方向相关失真，在不改变优化器和训练流程的前提下提升分布式LLM训练的通信效率与模型性能。
en_tdlr: GeoFP8 transforms gradients into a geometry-aware, near-isotropic coordinate space before quantization, substantially reducing direction-dependent distortion in FP8 gradient communication and improving distributed LLM training without changing the optimizer or training recipe.
